capabilities: Number every wrapped display row in the editor gutter
Switch between relative, hybrid, absolute and dual number modes
Highlight the cursor row number with a tinted background (Pro)
Show hover hints with the Vim motion that reaches a row (Pro)
Hide the gutter per note via a property (Pro)
extras: Freemium: the gutter and the four modes are free; counting folded lines, per-note property, cursor-row highlight, motion hints and per-mode colors need a GitHub Sponsors payment, and one payment unlocks Pro in every NoteMods plugin. Pro requires sign-in via the GitHub device flow and can work offline for at most 14 days. After updates the plugin opens a What's new tab that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; it can be turned off in settings. Requires turning off Obsidian's built-in 'Show line numbers' and Obsidian 1.13.4 or later.
intentEvidence: With Vimrc Support, add nmap j gj and nmap k gk to your vimrc file.
problem: Obsidian's built-in line numbers count source lines, so a wrapped paragraph is one number and counted Vim motions over wrapped text land on the wrong display row.

relations.evidence: With Vimrc Support, add nmap j gj and nmap k gk to your vimrc file.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Editor gutter plugin that numbers every wrapped display row, in relative, hybrid, absolute and dual modes, so counted Vim motions land on the shown row.
